description: Meet the 2009 Toyota RAV4 in striking Pacific Blue Metallic with a clean CARFAX and excellent overall condition  a practical, comfortable and dependable compact SUV that blends everyday usability with Toyotas long-standing reputation for reliability. Under the hood is the efficient 2.5L inline-4 engine delivering 179 hp and 172 lb-ft of torque, tuned to offer a smooth, predictable power delivery for city streets, highway cruising and light weekend adventures. EPA fuel-economy ratings for this drivetrain are an attractive 21 MPG city and 27 MPG highway, making it an economical choice for commuting or family errands.  Interior and Comfort Step inside and youll find the cabin trimmed in Ash, a light neutral tone that brightens the interior and presents a welcoming, airy feel. The RAV4 was designed with driver- and passenger-focused ergonomics in mind: supportive front seats, an adjustable drivers seating position and well-placed controls mean long drives are comfortable and low-fatigue. Seating is configured for five passengers with a versatile 60/40 split-folding rear seat that folds down to expand the cargo area for larger loads  groceries, sports gear, strollers or weekend luggage. Multiple cupholders, practical storage cubbies and a generously sized center console provide useful places to stow everyday items.  Climate and Conveniences This RAV4 is factory-equipped with efficient heating and air conditioning to keep everyone comfortable in all seasons, plus easy-to-use climate controls. Convenience features include power windows, power door locks and power-adjustable side mirrors, making routine tasks simple and intuitive. Cruise control helps keep highway cruising relaxed, while a tilt-adjustable steering column lets the driver dial in a comfortable hand position. The cabin also includes well-placed grab handles and thoughtfully located 12-volt power outlets for charging devices.  Audio and Connectivity The factory audio setup provides clear, easy-to-use entertainment and information. The head unit includes AM/FM radio and CD capability, along with auxiliary connectivity for portable music players. Sound is distributed through a well-tuned speaker array to deliver pleasant audio for daily commutes or longer trips. Convenient steering-wheel-mounted audio and cruise controls are positioned so you can make adjustments without taking your hands far from the wheel.  Safety and Peace of Mind Toyota equipped the 2009 RAV4 with a comprehensive suite of standard safety features to protect occupants. This vehicle includes dual front airbags, front seat-mounted side airbags and full-length side curtain airbags to help protect all rows in the event of a collision. Standard anti-lock brakes (ABS) help maintain steering control under hard braking, while electronic brake-force distribution (EBD) and brake assist systems optimize stopping performance. Traction control and vehicle stability control system help maintain composure in slippery or unpredictable driving conditions. In addition, the RAV4 is fitted with a Tire Pressure Monitoring System (TPMS) and LATCH anchors for child seat installation  features that emphasize practicality and family safety.  Exterior and Practicality The Pacific Blue Metallic finish presents beautifully and adds a touch of personality while remaining tasteful and easy to maintain. The RAV4s exterior styling balances functionality with a streamlined look: compact dimensions that make parking and maneuvering simple, a roomy cargo area accessible via an easy-to-use rear hatch and roofline designed to accommodate roof racks for bikes, cargo boxes or outdoor gear. Halogen headlamps and body-color trim elements were part of the original factory design to provide a clean, cohesive appearance.
